transformations: Public CLI replaces private CLI and ad hoc compiled hash helper.
Public development receiver has no native registration or policy issuance dependency.
Frozen task pins regenerated for public paths; private run data excluded.
Remove unused native packet and owned-request entry points from the bounded Python referee.
Promote only existing protocol framing/send logic to replace the public Rust test dependency on an absent private client. Exclude guest connector and submission/launch paths.
Bound complete worker frames and terminal EOF; limit stage logs; clean up owned process groups, including interrupted runs.
Independently verify replay using held directory-relative nonfollowing stable reads instead of inline path-based assertions.
Use a live controller listener for the bounded network-denial probe; task/source pins explicitly regenerated.
Cross-check original journal genesis and reject unsupported native-join claims without granting execution authority.

Keep private-to-public helper gates active under optimization; freeze approved bytes and atomically replace entries without truncating link targets. Remove unnecessary private repository identifiers from maintainer guidance.
Use the existing Linux candidate-channel guard by default and refuse Linux ARM before worker execution; explicitly provision rustfmt for contributor formatting checks.
Classify five pre-existing privileged ownership controls as explicit NOT_RUN/ignored instead of silent early-return PASS; no production behavior or qualification gate changed.
excluded: Native admission, signing and installed policies
Host qualification and provider control workflows

audit.rights_basis: Owner authorization for original project material plus selected-source attribution review; existing third-party notices preserved.
